name: Ravager's minimum range removal reaches the client as a visible aura (#7294, #7295, #7337)
contract: Ravager 92116 (Ranger Level 10 Passive, the Brigand identity granted by ChrSpecs 30 Dueling) reads 'Removes the minimum range of your ranged abilities.' Its SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_IGNORE_MIN_RANGE (312) effect already makes the server ignore the 5 yd minimum of SpellRange 54 shots such as Quick Shot 500074, Serrated Shot 500073 and Cutthroat 800359 (#5479, #5745). The 3.3.5 client checks minimum range itself and never sends a cast it judges too close, so it must see the aura. Aura::CanBeSentToClient sends a passive aura only with an area aura effect or SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE, so before the fix Ravager has no client-visible aura slot and players keep 'Target too close' on every shot that has a minimum range, while Skullpiercer 802036 (SpellRange 4, no minimum) works. Expected: after choosing the Dueling specialization at level 10 the Ranger knows Ravager, carries its aura in a client-visible slot, keeps it there after a relog, and the server accepts Quick Shot at 2 yds.

steps.label: SETUP: the Brigand specialization grants Ravager
SETUP: the Ravager aura is applied
DISCRIMINATING: the Ravager aura occupies a client-visible slot
After a relog the Ravager aura is still client-visible
CONTROL: the server accepts Quick Shot at 2 yds with Ravager
